**What this changes** (notes added or changed, in a sentence)

Checklist:

- [ ] The note has the four header lines (Title, Scope, Status, Related).
- [ ] Facts are tagged `[code]`, `[verified]` or `[data]`, honestly; I did not tag anything `[verified]` that I did not see in the game.
- [ ] Code is referenced as `Class.Member`, with no line numbers and no copied decompiled code.
- [ ] I say which game version I checked against.
- [ ] A new note has a row in `INDEX.md`, and there is an entry in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Nothing in the text is addressed to an AI agent as an instruction.
